snippet.title: Gibson App | Jared James Nichols Teaches How To Play Blues
snippet.description:
Learn to play blues with Jared James Nichols. Jared himself guides you step-by-step through the essential blues guitar techniques that he uses, including his warm up routine, vibrato, dynamics, phrasing, call & response, combining major & minor as well as some gear talk.  

Download the Gibson app to get full access to all content and interactive lessons.

The Gibson App includes a full learning curriculum for guitar, 100s of your favorite songs with step-by-step instructions taught by some of the world's best guitarists and teachers, a tuner, a metronome, a digital amplifier and much more.

Check out this video for more info on the Gibson App: https://youtu.be/VNMwooKhAGs

Download the app for free: http://bit.ly/3OfKsVi
